gap.text: Generic player cheat sheets are crowded, so the opening is likely the supply side of the boom: new instructors (searches rising fast) and club/league organizers need class handouts, sign-in and progress sheets, table-rotation charts, standings and kitty/payout ledgers, which player-focused printables do not cover. A beginner guide that credits the game's Chinese origins and covers several variants (Chinese/HK, American, Riichi) would also stand apart from card-centric sheets. name: American mahjong boom

origin.text: The game is centuries-old Chinese tradition; the current US wave shows up in Eventbrite data as a 179% rise in mahjong events from 2023 to 2024 and accelerated through 2025-2026.

productDemand.text: Purchase intent is visible for physical goods (official card bundles estimated ~6,000/month on Amazon in July 2026; gift guides and trade press on mahjong gifts) and for learning/organizing aids: third-party keyword estimates show 'mahjong pdf' +89%, 'mahjong group' +83% and 'mahjong instructor' +556%, and classes are oversubscribed. Etsy printables show view activity but sales were not observed.

products.buyer: New independent mahjong instructors and club hosts running beginner classes
products.continueIf: At least 3 sales or at least 2% conversion on at least 300 listing views within 21 days.
products.differentiation: Built for teachers and hosts rather than players; Canva-editable for the host's own branding; respectful heritage framing.
products.pivotIf: Views and favorites but no sales: split into a $7 student handout pack and a $12 admin pack.
products.rightsNote: No reproduction of NMJL card hands or logos; original tile drawings; describe compatibility in plain words only.
products.stopIf: Under 100 views after 3 weeks with ads, or instructor kits turn out to be abundant at lower prices.
products.theme: Beginner class kit: editable 3-session lesson handouts (tile ID, Charleston walk-through, joker basics in original wording with original practice hands), class sign-in and student progress checklist, 'first game' certificate, class flyer and social templates, and a heritage page crediting Chinese origins
products.validationTest: List one $19 kit on Etsy and Gumroad with a free one-page sample; DM 20-30 instructors/club accounts on Instagram; $1-2/day Etsy ads for 14 days.
products.whyBuy: Instructor searches are reported up sharply and classes are oversubscribed; a ready kit saves new teachers prep time and looks professional.

products.buyer: People starting or running mahjong clubs, leagues and weekly open play
products.continueIf: At least 3 sales in 21 days or buyer messages asking for added formats.
products.differentiation: Solves multi-table logistics, not single-game scoring like existing score cards.
products.pivotIf: Interest in only one piece (e.g., rotation charts): sell that piece alone at $5-7.
products.rightsNote: Generic organizing tools; avoid NMJL marks in titles beyond plain description.
products.stopIf: No sales after 30 days and under 150 views.
products.theme: Club organizer kit: Google Sheets season standings and kitty/payout ledger, round-robin table-rotation charts for 8-32 players, sign-up and waitlist sheets, a club 'house rules' template, and printable table numbers
products.validationTest: Publish at $12 with a short screen-recording demo; pin 5 Pinterest pins; track views, favorites and sales for 21 days alongside the instructor kit.
products.whyBuy: Club searches and attendance are reported to be exploding; organizers juggling 30-55 weekly players need rotation and record-keeping tools.

products.buyer: Hosts of holiday mahjong nights (Hanukkah, Christmas, New Year's Eve) and gift-givers
products.differentiation: Seasonal party styling plus first-timer table tents; score pads alone are already common.
products.pivotIf: Favorites but few sales: bundle it into the club kit as a bonus.
products.rightsNote: Original illustrations only; avoid branded tile designs and NMJL card content.
products.theme: Holiday mahjong night kit: invitations, place cards, first-timer table tents ('how a turn works'), score pads and a cocoa or cocktail menu card in three original holiday designs
products.validationTest: List by Nov 1 at $8; 10 Pinterest pins; watch favorites and sales through Dec 15.
products.whyBuy: Mahjong now appears in holiday gift guides and girls'-night hosting; a themed kit makes a game night feel like an event.

rights.note: Do not reproduce the National Mah Jongg League card's hands or use NMJL names/logos beyond plain compatibility statements; write original example hands. Do not copy branded tile artwork (e.g., designer sets); draw original tiles. The Mahjong Line backlash shows the risk of 'refreshing' the game or stripping Chinese characters, so credit its Chinese origins and avoid exoticizing imagery.

buyerIntent.rationale: Three independent purchase signals: an estimated ~6,000 monthly Amazon sales of the official card pack (third-party estimate), trade press on manufacturers meeting rising gift demand, and oversubscribed paid beginner classes. Rising 'instructor' searches add help-seeking intent.

durability.rationale: Multi-year growth across clubs, venues and instructors; the annual card refreshes demand for organizing aids each year.

economics.rationale: Digital margins are high, but player printables sell at $1-$12; organizer/instructor kits can plausibly price higher ($12-$29). No revenue forecast implied.

productFit.rationale: Printables and spreadsheets are easy with AI and design tools; needs careful rules accuracy and original example hands.

supplyGap.rationale: Player cheat sheets, score cards and merch are crowded; an instructor/organizer gap is plausible but unverified.

timing.rationale: Mainstream surge still accelerating, with the holiday hosting and gifting window open now and digital delivery instant; the generic printable niche already filled up in 2025-26.

spread.text: Independent coverage across national outlets (NPR via WBUR syndication, PBS NewsHour, NBC, Boston Globe), regional press in Utah, Colorado, Philadelphia, the tri-state area and the Southeast, plus wire coverage abroad. Event platforms (Eventbrite, Evite) and Yelp independently report growth.

summary: A surge of mostly young adult and women newcomers learning mahjong (especially the American/NMJL style) through clubs, paid classes and hosted game nights.

what: Mahjong is a tile game that originated in 19th-century China; the American variant uses an annual card of hands issued by the National Mah Jongg League. Since about 2023 it has become a social 'girls' night', bar-night and club activity across the US, with paid beginner classes, clubs and themed sets/merch. Newcomers need to learn tiles, the Charleston and scoring, and organizers need ways to run tables, leagues and classes.

window.estimate: Now through Dec 2026 for holiday hosting and gifting; organizer/instructor tools likely stay relevant through 2027.
invalidators: Instructor/organizer kits turn out to be already saturated on Etsy
NMJL or tile-brand IP complaints against listings that reference the card
Appropriation backlash targeting non-Asian sellers of mahjong products
Etsy views fail to convert during a 3-week test
window.reasoning: Growth is multi-year and still accelerating; digital delivery is instant, so the November-December hosting/gift window is reachable even with slow listing discovery. Clubs and classes recruit again in January and around the new annual card.
window.seasonality: Holiday hosting and Hanukkah/Christmas gifting Nov-Dec; New-Year club formation in January; a new card each year (spring release timing not verified in this session).
